name: Jupiter
description: The dominant Solana DEX aggregator and trade execution platform. Provides optimal swap routing across Solana liquidity sources, plus limit orders, DCA automation, perpetuals, and a lending market. The default execution layer for Solana trading agents.

ecosystem_fit.notes: The canonical token swap aggregator for Solana. Agents that execute trades on Solana route through Jupiter.

common_pairings.context: Helius provides onchain data and event triggers; Jupiter executes the resulting trade decisions.
Jupiter for routing/pricing, Jito for MEV-protected bundle submission of the resulting transactions.
Birdeye for market data signals, Jupiter for executing the resulting trades.

trust_evidence.description: Jupiter is the dominant DEX aggregator on Solana. Confirmed by official skill availability from the Jupiter team and appearance in sendaifun community skills.
Jupiter appears in every Solana trading agent workflow pattern in the corpus as the default execution layer.
Jupiter maintains an official agent skill with Ultra swaps, limit orders, DCA, perpetuals, and lending coverage.

scale_guidance.hackathon: Use Jupiter API (REST) — simplest integration, no SDK setup required.
scale_guidance.mvp: Jupiter API for swaps. Add limit orders if product requires it.
scale_guidance.production: Use Jupiter API with retry logic. Consider Ultra mode for MEV protection at higher volumes.

alternatives.when_to_prefer: When direct AMM interaction is needed (liquidity provision, specific pool management). Jupiter routes through Raydium but Raydium SDK is needed for LP operations.

anti_patterns: Using Jupiter for non-Solana chains — Jupiter is Solana-only.
Not implementing slippage protection when using Jupiter in automated agent contexts.
Skipping simulation before executing live Jupiter swaps in autonomous agents.
